description:
Department of Trade and Investment Policy - Regulation made to prescribe a method for determination of customs Value of Motor vehicles imported and that shall be in force from 14.06.2016	
y
categorisation: This gazette content establishes a regulation under the Customs Ordinance (Chapter 235) for determining the customs value of imported motor vehicles. It creates a legal framework and compliance requirements for customs valuation, which falls under the Legal/Regulatory classification. While it mentions the Minister of Finance by name, it does not describe his portfolio responsibilities in detail, and the primary purpose is regulatory/legal rather than personnel or organizational government matters.
